priorityList: Pre-combat: Buff Arcane Intellect and prepare to cast Blizzard or Glacial Spike as the pull starts.
Use offensive Trinkets, Potions, and Racial abilities during Frozen Orb or Ray of Frost windows.
Cast Blizzard immediately whenever the Freezing Rain buff is active.
Cast Frozen Orb on cooldown to generate procs and enable Freezing Rain.
Cast Glacial Spike as soon as you have 5 Icicles.
Use Flurry if you have a Brain Freeze proc (prioritize this when Icy Veins is not active).
Hardcast Blizzard if 3 or more targets are present and Frozen Orb will not be available soon.
Use Ice Lance whenever you have Fingers of Frost procs.
Use Ice Lance if the target has 10 or more stacks of the Freezing debuff.
Use Flurry whenever it is available to use to apply Winter's Chill.
Channel Ray of Frost as long as you do not have a Frostfire Empowerment buff active.
Cast Frostbolt as your primary filler to generate Icicles and Brain Freeze procs.
When moving, prioritize Blizzard (if Freezing Rain is active), Ice Nova, or Cone of Cold (if talented).
Use Ice Lance as a filler while moving if no other instant-cast abilities are available.
